fusions.name: Peel the Plate
fusions.desc: Catches a plate and tears it away, dealing 30 damage that ignores armour and leaving the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Lowered Shields
fusions.desc: Drags the barb across the guard of every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 4 damage, with a 35% chance per hit to leave them [Sundered] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Barbed Pauldrons
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, 60% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Gap Finder
fusions.desc: Your physical attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour, and your other abilities come round 4% sooner.
